interpretation: Target units; checks typical absolute errors.
Negative means worse than the specified origin-available benchmark.
Exact zero is a separate sign; magnitudes are ignored.
Undefined for a constant series; high correlation alone does not ensure small errors.
Positive variance forecasts required; main variance ranking score.
Daily-volatility scale. The square root of a variance forecast is not an expected volatility (Jensen), so this is an error on the root of the variance forecast.
Recorded for dynamic/volatility fits, not the OOS selection score.

formula: mean over calendar months of d = loss(reduced) - loss(expanded)
interpretation: Estimand of every paired comparison: paired same-month MSE for returns, QLIKE for variance. Identical forecasts give d = 0 exactly.

formula: 95% percentile interval, order statistics 50 and 1950 of B = 1999 circular block bootstrap means (blocks of 3, 6 or 12 months; 6 primary; seed 20260918)
interpretation: Resamples whole calendar months; conditional on saved forecasts, so estimation, tuning and specification-search uncertainty are not included.
Inverts the same interval: p <= 0.05 exactly when the 95% interval excludes zero. Monte Carlo resolution 0.001.

formula: Equal-weight average of the issuers' d within each calendar month, then the same bootstrap
interpretation: Whole months are resampled, never individual company-month rows.

formula: Holm step-down over the tested rows of one declared family (R16, RJ4, V20, VJ5)
interpretation: A multiplicity-adjusted decision; it need not agree with unadjusted interval exclusion. Other comparisons are exploratory.

formula: mean of (e_small^2 - (e_big^2 - (f_small - f_big)^2)), Newey-West t, one-sided
interpretation: Fixed nested OLS pairs only: population predictive content of extra regressors, not sample forecast accuracy.

formula: 2.80 x bootstrap standard error of the mean differential
interpretation: 80% power at 5% two-sided under a normal approximation; for returns also shown in OOS R-squared points relative to the historical mean.

formula: Rejection rate at nominal 5% over 500 synthetic null samples (stationary bootstrap of the demeaned observed differential)
interpretation: Calibration of the paired test for series like the observed ones; above 0.10 at the primary block means p-values are descriptive only.
Identical forecasts at every origin are an untested contrast, not evidence of no effect.

formula: 12-month RMSE, MAE, bias and OOS R2
interpretation: Overlapping windows are not independent evidence.
